subject: delta(client): WF refuse to prepare a payable purchase whose seller transport is not declared
note: prepareTerms refuses with seller_agent_unavailable, before anything is signed or saved, a purchase whose terms declare native payment but no seller transport. Every seller endpoint is a public https origin and the seller client sends only with the wire authentication the declared transport provides, so such a purchase would otherwise pass prepare, have the buyer sign identity, plan and Agreement, and fail at its first Agreement submit. The transport is declared only together with native payment evidence, so a missing evidence capability is refused the same way. A configuration without native payment can never pay and still prepares as before.
